selection_rationale: The SNL LFP archive is one bounded source with an official Battery Archive study page and a peer-reviewed Sandia publication. The package does not extend evidence across the other eight archives.

documents.authoritative_scope: study design, tested chemistry families, equipment, protocol groups, and regime-specific voltage limits
meaning and limitations of cell-ID chemistry, temperature, SOC-window, and C-rate labels

documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Scientific and Technical Information
documents.authoritative_scope: peer-reviewed article identity, DOI, authorship, research organization, and study abstract
Sandia publication identity, SAND number, DOI, journal, and study summary

evidence_claims.documented_value: Commercial 18650 LiFePO4 cell from A123 Systems, part APR18650M1A
evidence_claims.limitation: The documents identify the bounded study cell model, but the local archive entries have not been checksum-bound to those documented cells.
The nominal capacity is documented for the study cell model, but no verified local file-to-cell binding has been performed.

evidence_claims.documented_value: Cells were equilibrated in environmental chambers at designated cycling temperatures and cell-skin temperature was monitored by a K-type thermocouple.
evidence_claims.limitation: The documents describe study-level thermal control, but no cycle-specific local command or chamber-setpoint binding is established.

evidence_claims.documented_value: All cells used 0.5C charging; 0-100% SOC cycling used CCCV with a 30-minute or 0.05 A taper termination, and capacity checks used three 0.5C charge/discharge cycles.
evidence_claims.limitation: Study protocols are documented, but cycle-specific commanded charge steps are not bound to local records.

evidence_claims.documented_value: The study varied discharge rate and DOD; 40-60% SOC used capacity limits, 20-80% SOC used voltage limits established from fresh-cell discharge curves, and capacity checks used 0.5C discharge.
evidence_claims.limitation: Protocol groups are documented, but the local cycles have no verified commanded discharge-step binding.

evidence_claims.documented_value: For the 100% DOD regime, LFP cells were cycled from 2.0 V to 3.6 V.
evidence_claims.limitation: The voltage limits are regime-specific and are not a verified cutoff policy for every local file or cycle.

evidence_claims.documented_value: Cycling used Arbin SCTS and Arbin LBT21084 systems, SPX Tenney T10C-1.5 chambers, and K-type thermocouples attached to cell skins.
evidence_claims.limitation: Equipment identity is documented, but channel mapping, calibration certificates, accuracy, drift, and measurement uncertainty are absent.

evidence_claims.documented_value: DOI 10.1149/1945-7111/abae37, OSTI 1650174, and SAND2020-8433J identify the study publication.
evidence_claims.limitation: Publication identifiers do not identify a versioned Battery Archive distribution or prove that the local SNL LFP.zip is an exact official snapshot.

target_contract.source_metric: capacity retention relative to nominal capacity, with 80% used as an end-of-life benchmark
target_contract.alignment_limitation: The source study metric does not by itself establish the exact five-cycle-ahead target construction used in v2.6.1.
